prompt: Write a list of 20 animated films from the 1990s, in the following format: “[TITLE] ([YEAR]), by [DIRECTORS]”. Do not write any descriptions, or sort in any order.
judge_reasoning: Candidate [1] best satisfies the prompt by listing exactly 20 animated films all from the 1990s and using the required item format without added descriptions. Candidate [2] largely follows the format but violates the key constraint by including multiple films from 2000, and has some director-list/accuracy looseness. Candidate [4] also includes several major constraint violations (notably non-animated/live-action and post-1990s titles) and adds extra descriptive text, while [3] has the most failures by mixing in non-animated and out-of-range titles and not adhering well to the specified format.
